title: Claude Code
intro: Anthropic's coding agent, headless over stream-json. Any Anthropic-shaped provider: the default is DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint.

verified.how: hg harness run against DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint, two turns

notes: Point the provider at an Anthropic Messages endpoint (api: anthropic-messages); the model the request names is pinned for every alias the CLI uses.
Continuation resumes the CLI's own session (--resume), kept in the session state; the transcript lives in the member's home, so the home is kept per member and package.
MCP servers in the request's tools become --mcp-config with --strict-mcp-config: only those servers, nothing from the home.
